summary: This article explains how Rayyanah Barnawi and Ali AlQarni traveled to the International Space Station in 2023, lived in microgravity, did experiments with students on Earth, and became a milestone for Saudi Arabia.
introduce: Write First, Next, Then, and Finally on the board and ask a volunteer to use them to describe how they get ready for school. Tell students to watch for the order of events as they read “Saudi Astronauts in Space”.

keyTerms.def: an important trip or job that a group is sent to do
one full trip around a planet or star along a curved path
a condition in space where the pull of gravity feels so small that things seem to float

challengeTerms.def: a small closed spacecraft that carries astronauts to and from space
careful study to discover new facts
to make someone want to do something great

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that sending astronauts to space is a good way to get students interested in science? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Explain why the experiments done by students in Saudi Arabia were an important part of this mission.
struggling: Read the first part of the article aloud together, review mission, orbit, and microgravity, and let weak readers put sentence strips of the main events in order before writing.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use capsule, research, and inspire in a short paragraph that summarizes the key events in order and explain which step matters most.
